description: This file implements Netlink socket communication, including serialization/deserialization of messages, sending and receiving data, and managing pending messages within the Thunder::Core namespace. It is specific to Linux systems and includes debug functionality.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Handles serialization/deserialization of netlink messages and maintains a sequence ID.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Manages socket communication, including sending, receiving, and managing pending messages.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into netlink message components.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message through the socket, with a wait time.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a response, exchanging netlink messages.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares data to be sent over the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data from the socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for the socket.
